features.name: outside-agent run picks agy's model and effort
features.description: Owner request 2026-10-30: raise outside agents on Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon, Opus 5.5 or GPT through agy. agy 1.4.11 serves gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-4-argon, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5 (low/medium/high) and gpt-oss-120b (medium); --effort must match a suffixed name. `outside-agent.sh run` had no way to choose: review pinned gemini-4-argon-high, delegate took agy's default, and every agy row was logged as family gemini.
acceptance_criteria: run --model <name> [--effort <level>] passes them to agy for review and delegate, and tries agy only
--effort without --model, a name outside [a-z0-9.-], or --model with no agy in the conf exits 2 without running an agent
the run log names the model and the family it implies (claude-, gpt-, gemini-)
features.evidence: scripts/outside_agent.py: run --model (MODEL_RE [a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,63}) and --effort (low..max, needs --model); with --model the conf narrows to agy (exit 2 if absent); review keeps the allowlist path (no skip-permissions, note prepended), delegate adds the model after its permission flags; --effort passed only when given, as agy rejects a level that differs from the name's. Attempt and run rows carry model and model_family (claude-/gpt-/gemini-, else unknown); stderr says used=agy model=X. Tests first: 22 new cases failed, 227 pass after; mypy clean. Live: review via claude-opus-5-5 --effort medium answered (logged family claude); gemini-4-argon-low --effort high exited 2. Found while testing: agy delegates in this repo time out because agy runs the repo's Stop hook gates (~100 s) after answering (PROGRESS Blockers). Reviews: two subagents (correctness, security): no confirmed defects. README documents --model. Follow-up 2026-10-30: an outside Flash-high review ended on a refused grep -rn "a\|b" (4 of 19 agy reviews ended on a refused command), so AGY_REVIEW_NOTE now says to search with grep -e a -e b; a test checks that form passes the allowlist and the refused one does not.
